Advertisement Advertisement HFM, an official partner of Arsenal FC, brought the Premier League trophy to the Landmark Events Centre in Victoria Island, where supporters enjoyed a day of football activities, entertainment and fan engagement. The event attracted thousands of Arsenal supporters and other football enthusiasts, who posed with the trophy and took photographs to mark the occasion. Fans also participated in interactive football activities and games, while live entertainment added to the atmosphere at the venue. Read Also: 5 numbers behind Arsenal’s historic Premier League title triumph Opeoluwa Abiola, managing director of HF Markets Nigeria Limited, said the turnout reflected the strong following football and Arsenal enjoy in Nigeria. Advertisement “The passion for football here in Nigeria is incredible, and seeing so many Arsenal supporters and football fans come together in Lagos has been truly special,” Abiola said. “Through our partnership with Arsenal FC, we want to go beyond traditional sponsorship and create experiences that bring fans closer to the game they love. Lagos has been a fantastic start to our Africa Trophy Tour, and we’re proud to share this moment with the local football community.” Advertisement HFM takes trophy tour to other African cities The Lagos event marked the first stop of the HFM x Arsenal FC Africa Trophy Tour 2026, an initiative aimed at bringing the club’s history and heritage closer to supporters across the continent. Advertisement Advertisement Following the Lagos showcase, the tour will move to Nairobi on November 19 before heading to Cape Town on November 21. The events will give more Arsenal supporters and football fans across Africa the opportunity to see the Premier League trophy and participate in activities celebrating their connection with the club. The tour forms part of HFM’s partnership with Arsenal FC, through which the financial services company seeks to deepen its engagement with football communities across the continent.
